name: NanoGPT
summary: OpenAI-compatible model gateway with separate personal subscription monitoring. Account tier and model coverage remain unknown until confirmed.

credentials.label: NanoGPT inference API key
credentials.help: Use browser sign-in or an existing inference key. Never enter a management token here.

setupSteps.title: Connect your NanoGPT account
setupSteps.description: Use Sign in with NanoGPT or privately enter an existing inference API key. Connecting alone creates no model route.

setupSteps.title: Add subscription monitoring
setupSteps.description: Create a separate management token with Usage only (usage:read). No account ID is required; the token reads its own personal subscription.

setupSteps.title: Choose optional model routes
setupSteps.description: Model templates do not establish subscription coverage. Check current coverage and key billing settings before routing requests; inference keys may spend balance.

billingPlans.name: Existing account billing settings
billingPlans.notes: Subscription tier, price, included limits and coverage are unknown. A public model listing is not proof of inclusion. No purchase or paid fallback is enabled by setup.

routes.name: DeepSeek V3.2
restrictions: Subscription coverage and account billing settings must be confirmed before use.

restrictions: Subscription coverage and account billing settings must be confirmed before use.
OAuth api.use returns a spend-capable inference API key; it cannot read Management API subscription quotas.
Management tokens are separate, quota-only credentials and must never reach inference.
Monitor results identify no user or account; association with an inference credential is unverified.
Optional templates are present in the public catalog; capabilities, current prices and subscription inclusion are unverified.
